reason: I've already got a charter system with years of bookings, customers and driver records in it, and it works well enough. I take calls and drive runs myself, so I don't have the hours to babysit a second system for 60 days for a company with no customers yet.
objection: It's brand new with nobody else running on it. If the migration drops something or it falls over on a busy wedding Saturday, it's my coaches and my name on the line, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three operators my size actually running it for six months or so, and my current provider jacking up their price or letting me down badly.
